cards.front: Who was the first martyr of the Telangana Armed Struggle (1946-1951)?
cards.back: Doddi Komarayya was the first martyr of the Telangana Armed Struggle.
cards.key_fact: Doddi Komarayya was the first martyr of the Telangana Armed Struggle.

cards.front: Which peasant leader famously resisted the oppression of landlord Visnoor Deshmukh?
cards.back: Chityala Ailamma (Chakali Ilamma) resisted the oppression of Visnoor Deshmukh.
cards.key_fact: Chityala Ailamma led peasant resistance against Visnoor Deshmukh.

cards.front: What was the code name of the Indian military action that integrated Hyderabad State into India in 1948?
cards.back: The military action was code-named Operation Polo.
cards.key_fact: Operation Polo integrated Hyderabad State into the Indian Union in September 1948.

cards.front: In which year was the Gentlemen's Agreement signed to safeguard Telangana interests?
cards.back: The Gentlemen's Agreement was signed in 1956.
cards.key_fact: The Gentlemen's Agreement was signed in 1956 prior to the formation of Andhra Pradesh.

cards.front: Who founded the Telangana Praja Samithi (TPS) at the start of the 1969 agitation?
cards.back: Ananthula Madan Mohan founded the Telangana Praja Samithi in 1969.
cards.key_fact: Ananthula Madan Mohan founded TPS in 1969 to lead the statehood agitation.

cards.front: In which year did K. Chandrashekar Rao found the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS)?
cards.back: K. Chandrashekar Rao founded the Telangana Rashtra Samithi in 2001.
cards.key_fact: TRS was founded in 2001 by K. Chandrashekar Rao to demand separate statehood.

cards.front: Which committee was appointed by the Central Government in 2010 to study the Telangana statehood demand?
cards.back: The Justice B.N. Srikrishna Committee was appointed in 2010.
cards.key_fact: The Srikrishna Committee was formed in 2010 to evaluate the Telangana issue.

cards.front: Who served as the Chairman of the Telangana Joint Action Committee (TJAC)?
cards.back: Professor M. Kodandaram served as the Chairman of the TJAC.
cards.key_fact: Professor M. Kodandaram led the TJAC during the statehood movement.

cards.front: In which year was the historic Million March organized in Hyderabad for Telangana statehood?
cards.back: The Million March was organized on Tank Bund in the year 2011.
cards.key_fact: The Million March took place in Hyderabad in 2011.

cards.front: On which exact date was the state of Telangana officially formed?
cards.back: Telangana was officially formed on June 2, 2014.
cards.key_fact: June 2, 2014 is the official formation date of Telangana State.
